senses.gloss:
A. As an indefinite article before nouns singular, for the
most part not expressed in Sanskrit; as, ‘a lion,’ सिंहः;
(One) एकः -का -कं.
— (Some, a certain) कश्चित्; as, ‘a certain
man,’ कश्चित् पुरुषः.
— (Each, every) expressed by प्रति or अनु,
before the acc. neut.; as, ‘a day,’ ‘each day,’ प्रतिदिनं or
अनुदिनं. When ‘a’ comes before a participle, after a
verb of motion, it is expressed by the dat. c.; as, ‘he went
a hunting,’ मृगयायै गतः; or by अर्थं preceded by the crude
form of a noun; as, मृगयार्थं गतः; or by the infinitive; as,
मृगयां कर्त्तुं गतः.
